text:
sam: Quick poll — taco truck (🌮), ramen van (🍜), or sushi pop-up (🍣) for next Friday lunch? Vote with emoji. Thanks!
leila: 🌮 tacos all the way. local truck has great al pastor.
owen: 🍜 ramen for me. can we get vegetarian option?
nina: 🍣 sushi please. low-effort for GF options? also +1 for vegetarian ramen.
alex: leaning ramen but if sushi, can we get delivery boxes? :thinking_face: 
sam: @here we're trying to decide — if ramen wins i'll see if they can do bento boxes; tacos if enough tortillas are gluten-free.
deploy-bot: Reminder: free lunch budget cap is $250 for Friday.
leila: noted, maybe we do tacos bento style and split sides? :shrug: 
owen: quick poll result so far: 🌮 1, 🍜 2, 🍣 1
nina: also +1 for ramen if we can get miso veggie.
sam: I'll tally final votes Friday 11am. Drop emoji to vote. :thumbsup: 
alex: 🍜
leila: 🌮
maria: 🍣 (remote but would contribute)
sam: cool — thanks everyone!
